description: A false-colour satellite image depicts the coastal area around Golfo di Signo in Sardinia, Italy, as captured in 2012 by Eurostat as part of the LUCAS (Land Use/Cover Area frame Survey) programme. The image features a prominent, bright blue coastal lagoon centrally located, with surrounding land areas predominantly appearing in bright red, characteristic of healthy vegetation reflecting strongly in the near-infrared spectrum. This vegetated land likely represents agricultural fields or natural landscapes. In the upper left quadrant, an airport is visible, distinguished by light grey runways and associated infrastructure. The open sea along the coastline is represented in a darker blue. A continuous, thin green line delineates a specific boundary that encloses the lagoon, sections of the airport, and the surrounding terrestrial areas, indicating a defined zone for analysis or classification.
